description: Hide the license plates in a car photo without changing anything else, for privacy before publishing a listing. Use this when the background should stay as it is; when the background is being replaced as well, set `hide_license_plate` on generate_background instead of calling both. `style` chooses a blur (default) or a solid `block`, and `block_color` sets the block's colour. Uses no credits: it is included with an active subscription, up to a fair-use monthly limit, and returns `subscription_required` for a workspace without one. The source photo is not modified; the result is returned as an image, with the areas that were hidden listed as `plates`.

block_color.description: Hex colour of the block, e.g. #FFFFFF. Default black.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the car photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

style.description: Blur the plate (default) or cover it with a block.

name: hide_license_plates
title: Hide license plates
